block.dreamtvs.lcd_panel.tooltip.summary: A slim _screen panel_ for _Dream Displays_. Place panels side by side to build _one bigger screen_.
block.dreamtvs.lcd_panel.tooltip.behavio: Panels on the same wall, facing the same way, _merge_ into one screen once they fill a _rectangle_. Never merges with other kinds of TV.
The screen _grows_, _shrinks_ or _splits_ to fit the panels and _keeps its video_.
Opens the _Dream Displays menu_ to set a _video link_ and playback options.
block.dreamtvs.crt_tv.tooltip.summary: A _late-80s_ tube TV. Plays video in _4:3_ with _scanlines_ and a soft _phosphor glow_.
block.dreamtvs.crt_tv.tooltip.behaviour1: Becomes a _screen of its own_. CRTs _never merge_, even when placed side by side.
block.dreamtvs.crt_tv.tooltip.behaviour2: Opens the _Dream Displays menu_ to set a _video link_ and playback options.
block.dreamtvs.jumbotron.tooltip.summary: A full-block screen with _no bezel_. Build huge, seamless _video walls_.
block.dreamtvs.jumbotron.tooltip.behavio: Jumbotrons on the same wall, facing the same way, _merge_ into one screen once they fill a _rectangle_. Never merges with _LCD Panels_.
The screen _grows_, _shrinks_ or _splits_ to fit the blocks and _keeps its video_.
Opens the _Dream Displays menu_ to set a _video link_ and playback options.
block.dreamtvs.flat_screen_2x1.tooltip.s: A thin _wall-mounted_ TV, _2 blocks wide_ and _1 tall_. Flat Screens _never merge_.
block.dreamtvs.flat_screen_2x1.tooltip.b: Places the _whole TV_ at once, from the clicked spot _to the right_. Needs the space to be _free_.
Breaking _any part_ removes the whole TV and drops it as _one item_.
Opens the _Dream Displays menu_ to set a _video link_ and playback options.
block.dreamtvs.flat_screen_3x2.tooltip.s: A big _wall-mounted_ TV, _3 blocks wide_ and _2 tall_. Flat Screens _never merge_.
block.dreamtvs.flat_screen_3x2.tooltip.b: Places the _whole TV_ at once, _centred_ on the clicked spot and going _up_. Needs the space to be _free_.
Breaking _any part_ removes the whole TV and drops it as _one item_.
Opens the _Dream Displays menu_ to set a _video link_ and playback options.
message.dreamtvs.not_rectangle: No screen: the panels must fill a rectangle
message.dreamtvs.too_wide: No screen: it can be at most %s panels wide
message.dreamtvs.too_tall: No screen: it can be at most %s panels tall
message.dreamtvs.limit_reached: No screen: you've reached the limit of %s screens
message.dreamtvs.no_permission: No screen: you don't have permission to create screens
message.dreamtvs.refused: Dream Displays wouldn't create a screen here
message.dreamtvs.not_ready: Dream Displays isn't ready yet, try placing the panel again
message.dreamtvs.no_room: No room: this screen needs a free %sx%s space
message.dreamtvs.menu_fallback: Sneak + right-click the screen to open the Dream Displays menu
dreamtvs.config.title: Dream TVs Settings
dreamtvs.config.note.menu: For your singleplayer and LAN worlds. Servers have their own config/dreamtvs.json.
dreamtvs.config.note.world: For this world and your other singleplayer worlds. Saving applies them now.
dreamtvs.config.note.server: These are for your own worlds. This server uses its own config/dreamtvs.json.
dreamtvs.config.note.unreadable: config/dreamtvs.json has a mistake, so defaults are shown. Saving replaces it.
dreamtvs.config.note.recipes: Recipe changes apply when a world loads, or after /reload.
dreamtvs.config.maxWidth.tooltip: The widest screen LCD Panels and Jumbotrons can build, in blocks (1 to 128). CRTs and Flat Screens have a fixed size.
dreamtvs.config.maxHeight.tooltip: The tallest screen LCD Panels and Jumbotrons can build, in blocks (1 to 128). CRTs and Flat Screens have a fixed size.
dreamtvs.config.maxScreensPerPlayer.tool: How many TV screens each player may own. 0 means unlimited. Players with dreamdisplays.create.bypass (or op level 2) can go over it.
dreamtvs.config.extendPolicy.tooltip: Who can grow, shrink, break or merge a screen. Who can change the video is set per screen in the Dream Displays menu.
dreamtvs.config.extendPolicy.owner.toolt: Only the player who built the screen, or an admin (dreamdisplays.delete.others or op level 2), can grow, shrink, break or merge it.
dreamtvs.config.extendPolicy.anyone.tool: Every player can grow, shrink, break or merge any screen.
dreamtvs.config.showFormMessages.tooltip: Show "Screen formed" and "panels must fill a rectangle" on the action bar. Refusals (no permission, limit reached, someone else's screen) are always shown.
dreamtvs.config.recipeSource.tooltip: Whose parts the TV recipes use.
dreamtvs.config.recipeSource.auto.toolti: Use the first installed mod in this list, else the vanilla recipes. The server log says which recipes are in use.
dreamtvs.config.recipeSource.vanilla.too: The normal crafting-table recipes, even when tech mods are installed.
dreamtvs.config.recipeSource.missing: Recipes made with parts from %s, which isn't installed. Until it is, Auto is used.
dreamtvs.config.recipeSource.unknown: "%s" isn't a recipe source Dream TVs knows. Auto is used.
With Create installed, TVs are made in a Create sequenced assembly (deployers and a press) using the parts above. Off: at a crafting table.
dreamtvs.config.toast.reload: Run /reload to use the new recipes
dreamtvs.config.toast.failed: Couldn't save the Dream TVs settings
